skills.name: scan-agent-readiness
skills.description: Agent Ready (agent-ready.dev) scores any website against 72 agent-readability checks (site, page, llms.txt, agent protocols) and returns per-check pass/fail with fix guidance.

skills.name: agent-ready-api
skills.description: Use the Agent Ready (agent-ready.dev) REST API to scan any public URL for AI agent-readability — start a scan, poll for results, handle errors. For tool-native access, use agent-ready-mcp instead. Install: npx skills add mlava/agent-ready-skills/skills/agent-ready-api

skills.name: agent-ready-mcp
skills.description: Install and use the Agent Ready (agent-ready.dev) MCP server (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Continue, Goose) to scan any URL for AI agent-readability via MCP tool calls. For direct REST access, use agent-ready-api instead. Install: npx skills add mlava/agent-ready-skills/skills/agent-ready-mcp

skills.name: agent-ready-cli
skills.description: Use the Agent Ready (agent-ready.dev) command-line client (agent-ready / npm agent-ready-scanner) to scan any URL for AI agent-readability in one terminal command — scan, get, list, ask. Best when the agent can run shell commands. For raw HTTP use agent-ready-api; for MCP tool calls use agent-ready-mcp. Install: npx skills add mlava/agent-ready-skills/skills/agent-ready-cli
